faq1.title: How does Quick Deposit work?
faq1.content:
Quick Deposit allows you to easily deposit USDT by converting OV purchased in your personal wallet from KRWO to USDT through wallet signing.



To better understand, remember these key concepts:

description.concept1: OV: A voucher equivalent to 10,000 KRWO
description.concept2: KRWO: A KRW stablecoin that can be exchanged for other cryptocurrencies

faq2.title: Why purchase OV (Open Voucher)?
faq2.content: Purchasing OV (Open Voucher) is the first essential step before exchanging for USDT. OV is required to issue KRWO, which is then exchanged for USDT.

faq3.title: Issue with Open Voucher purchase.
faq3.content: Open Voucher is a third-party service separate from GimSwap. For inquiries regarding the OV purchase process, please contact Open Voucher

faq4.title: Received a notice to retry during Quick Deposit.
faq4.content: If the USDT price fluctuates sharply and the exchange fails, please retry. Please follow the instructions and try again.

faq5.title: What is the fee for?
faq5.content: This is the fee for exchanging KRWO to USDT on GimSwap and depositing it into your Binance wallet.

faq6.title: Can I only use Binance wallet?
faq6.content: Quick Deposit feature is available only for Binance users, and the service is limited to Binance wallets.

faq7.title: How do I transfer USDT from Binance wallet?
faq7.content:
1. In Binance's Assets menu, click Wallet at the top.

2. Click 'Send' in the Wallet Assets menu and select the USDT token.

3. Enter the USDT amount and select 'Binance Deposit Address' in the 'To' field.

4. Transfer to Spot completed!

faq8.title: USDT not deposited in wallet.
faq8.content: Transfer may be delayed and take up to 3 minutes. If not received, contact GimSwap at contact@gimswap.com.
